# Top Pocket Decks

> Top Pocket Decks ranks Pokemon TCG Pocket decks and cards from Limitless tournament results. It publishes deck profiles, win rates, matchups and meta statistics, refreshed four times a week as new results come in.

## Tier list

- [Deck tier list](https://pocketdecks.top/tier-list/): every archetype ranked from tournament data, with win rates and matchups.

## Card rankings

- [Card tier list](https://pocketdecks.top/cards-list/): which cards win games, scored from tournament deck lists.

## Statistics

- [Meta statistics and trends](https://pocketdecks.top/statistics/): meta share, weekly deck movement and matchup statistics.

## Expansions

- [Expansion list](https://pocketdecks.top/expansion-list/): every expansion with its card count and meta impact.

## About and methodology

- [About and methodology](https://pocketdecks.top/about/): how decks are ranked from Limitless tournament data, and who maintains the project.

## Sitemap

- [Sitemap](https://pocketdecks.top/sitemap.xml): every page on the site.

## Use and security policy

The site may be fetched to answer user questions, provided the answer credits Top Pocket Decks with attribution.

Automated vulnerability scanning, exploitation, credential testing and any other unauthorised access are prohibited. Unauthorised access is an offence under the UK Computer Misuse Act 1990 and equivalent laws elsewhere.

Good-faith security reports go only through the process in [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/PocketDecks/pokemon-tcg-pocket-tier-list/blob/main/SECURITY.md).
